purpose: Teach: 捉える/深海/追放/パンク/捏造/形跡/失調/大名

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、捉える、絶対、視点、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled that perspective in your paper—I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, steady recognition. Leans forward slightly. Clear-eyed and direct, not effusive. Measured pace, each phrase given its weight. The tone of someone who means what she says.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本気で、絶対、深海、絶対、生態、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. That deep-sea ecology research took a lot of work, and I really appreciate you noticing.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, a little surprised by the praise. Steady voice, no false modesty. Speaks from genuine relief that the effort was seen. Respectful but not strained.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、追放、絶対、され、絶対、た、絶対、思想家、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you discussed that exiled thinker's ideas—there was real depth there.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective pace. Slight pause between clauses. Nodding approval in the voice. Not just pleasant—genuinely considering what was well done. Specific, not generic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。電力網の、本気で、絶対、パンク、絶対、現象、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Getting into the power grid collapse and its causes took careful research, and I'm grateful you recognized that.
lines.style: Slightly more confident than before, but still humble. The voice of someone who put real work in and is glad it landed. Clear, without rushing. Small, genuine smile underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: データの、本気で、絶対、捏造、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The attention you gave to data integrity—how thoroughly you handled that—it shows real scholarship.
lines.style: Engaged and specific. Leans in slightly. Speaks with the kind of recognition that comes from genuinely reading the work. Not flattering—observant. Warm without being performative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古代遺跡の、本気で、絶対、形跡、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Looking at the archaeological evidence from that site—there was so much work behind it.
lines.style: Acknowledging nod in the voice. Straightforward and clear. A bit of relief that this too was understood. No need to overstate—the work speaks for itself. Calm, grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 自律神経の、本気で、絶対、失調、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The autonomic nervous system section—you really unpacked that with care and nuance.
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Slower pace. The tone of someone recalling specific, solid work. Not rushing the compliment. Genuine appreciation for the attention to detail.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦国時代の、本気で、絶対、大名、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Tracing the daimyo's roles across that period required patience, and I'm thankful you saw the research behind it.
lines.style: Warmed and steadier now. Still respectful, but the guard is down slightly. Speaks with quiet confidence about the work. Genuine, not rehearsed. Grateful but grounded.
